senses.gloss: भुशुण्ड भुशुण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a man.

भुशुण्डि भुशुण्डि, इस्, or भुशुण्डी, f. a kind
of weapon, (perhaps a kind of fire-arms; sometimes
incorrectly written भुषुण्डि and भूशुण्डि.)

भूष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, = भविष्णु, भवितृ,
being, becoming, being or faring well; desiring
happiness, wishing for wealth and prosperity (see
Manu IV. 135).

भूष् भूष्, cl. 1. P. भूषति, बुभूष,
भूषितुम्, to strive after, use efforts for,
care for (with dat., Ved.); to adorn, decorate; (in
the Veda a rt. भूष् is found, which is regarded by
Sāy. as a form of 1. भू in the sense of ‘to obtain,
attain;’ thus in Ṛg-veda IV. 16, 11. भूषात् =
प्र-भवते, and in VIII. 92, 26. भूषसि = भ-
वसि); cl. 10. or Caus. भूषयति (rarely A. -ते),
भूषयाम्-आस, भूषयितुम्, to adorn, decorate,
embellish, attire; to spread or strew over with (any-
thing); to adorn one's self (A.); [cf. Hib. beosai-
ghim, ‘I adorn.’]

भूषण, अस्, ई, अम्, decorating, adorning; (अस्),
m. an epithet of Viṣṇu; N. of a Daitya; (अस्, अम्), m.
n. ornament, decoration, embellishment (generally
[]
अम्, n., often at the end of comps., cf. कर्ण-भ्˚;
sometimes at the end of an adj. comp., e. g. कनक-
भूषण, अस्, आ, अम्, decorated with gold); (अम्),
n. ‘the act of decorating or adorning,’ N. of a work.
—भूषण-ता, f. the being an ornament, ornature.
—भूषण-सार-दर्पण, अस्, m. ‘mirror of
the essence of decoration,’ N. of a commentary on
the Vaiyākaraṇa-bhūṣaṇa.
—भूषणेन्द्र-प्रभ
(˚ण-इन्˚), अस्, m., N. of a king of the Kinnaras.
भूषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be adorned, &c.

भूषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. striving after; (Sāy.)
adorning, ornamenting (= भूषयत्, अलङ्कुर्वत्).

भूषयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be decorated or
ornamented, to be adorned.

भूषयित्वा, ind. having adorned, having deco-
rated.

भूषा, f. adorning, decorating, ornament, deco-
ration; a jewel; [cf. कर्ण-भ्˚, बाहु-भ्˚.]

भूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned, decorated, orna-
mented, embellished, garnished.

भूषिन्, ई, इणी, इ (fr. भूषा), adorned or deco-
rated with (usually at the end of comps.).
भूष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be adorned or decorated.
